name: Exp_Instantaneous_TrendFilter
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover signals of the Instantaneous TrendFilter indicator, which uses an Ehlers-style alpha smoothing constant. It opens buy positions when the trend filter oscillator crosses above its signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Instantaneous TrendFilter指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标使用Ehlers风格的alpha平滑常数。当趋势滤波振荡器上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用Instantaneous TrendFilter指标作为核心策略，这是一个基于John Ehlers瞬时趋势滤波理论的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：指标缓冲区1上穿缓冲区0时产生买入信号，缓冲区1下穿缓冲区0时产生卖出信号，采用相邻两根K线的交叉判定方式。出场条件包括：反向交叉信号触发平仓（买入信号时平卖仓，卖出信号时平买仓），以及固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，默认为0.1手或账户资金的0.1%，支持手数模式和资金比例模式两种仓位计算方式。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现，允许用户通过BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen和BuyPosClose/SellPosClose参数分别控制开仓和平仓的启用状态。策略使用SignalBar参数控制信号确认的延迟，默认为1表示使用前一根已收盘K线的信号，避免未收盘K线的信号漂移问题。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the Instantaneous TrendFilter indicator as its core strategy, which is based on John Ehlers' instantaneous trend filter theory for trend following. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 crosses above buffer 0, and a sell signal is generated when buffer 1 crosses below buffer 0, using a two-bar crossover detection method comparing consecutive bars. Exit conditions include: reverse crossover signals trigger position closure (buy signal closes sell positions, sell signal closes buy positions), along with fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, defaulting to 0.1 lots or 0.1% of account funds, supporting both lot mode and margin proportion mode for position calculation. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions, allowing users to separately enable/disable buy/sell opening and closing through BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose parameters. The strategy uses the SignalBar parameter to control signal confirmation delay, defaulting to 1 to use the previously closed bar's signal, avoiding signal drift issues from unclosed bars.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 仓位大小参数，根据MMMode决定为手数或资金比例
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter controlling position size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：手数模式或资金比例模式
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot or margin ratio)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平卖仓）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平买仓）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引，1表示前一根已收盘K线

parameters.name: Alpha
parameters.description: 瞬时趋势滤波器的alpha平滑常数
parameters.description_en: Alpha smoothing constant for instantaneous trend filter

pros: 使用Ehlers瞬时趋势滤波理论，相比简单均线交叉具有更低的延迟和更好的趋势识别能力
提供了灵活的仓位管理选项，支持手数模式和资金比例模式
买卖开仓和平仓可独立控制，便于灵活配置策略行为
使用SignalBar=1避免未收盘K线信号漂移，提高了信号的可靠性
设有固定止损止盈，具备基本的风险控制机制
pros_en: Uses Ehlers' instantaneous trend filter theory, which has lower lag and better trend identification than simple moving average crossovers
Provides flexible position sizing options supporting both lot mode and margin proportion mode
Buy/sell opening and closing can be independently controlled, allowing flexible strategy behavior configuration
Uses SignalBar=1 to avoid signal drift from unclosed bars, improving signal reliability
Includes fixed stop loss and take profit, providing basic risk control mechanisms
cons: 止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR），在不同波动环境下效果差异大
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
未对持仓数量进行限制，在震荡行情中可能频繁开平仓导致过度交易
依赖外部自定义指标文件，部署时需确保指标文件存在
Alpha参数为固定值，未提供自适应调节机制，在不同市场状态下可能需要人工调整
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values without ATR-based volatility adaptation, leading to inconsistent performance across varying volatility environments
Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
No limit on number of open positions, potentially causing over-trading with frequent open/close cycles in choppy markets
Depends on an external custom indicator file, requiring the indicator file to be present during deployment
Alpha parameter is fixed with no adaptive adjustment mechanism, requiring manual tuning for different market conditions
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离，提高策略在不同波动环境下的适应性
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，减少不利条件下入场和过度交易的风险
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust SL/TP distances based on market volatility, improving adaptability across different volatility environments
Add spread filtering and maximum open position limits to reduce the risk of unfavorable entries and over-trading

risk_points: 固定止损1000点较大，在小周期品种上可能导致较大亏损
缺少点差过滤和最大持仓限制，震荡行情可能频繁触发信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed 1000-point stop loss is relatively large and may lead to significant losses on instruments with smaller tick values
Lack of spread filter and maximum position limits may cause frequent signal triggers and consecutive losses in choppy markets
